name: Shard of Omnipotence
lore: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.
concept: a jagged white-gold splinter of the shattered Omnipotence Core; light leaks from its cracks; it keeps trying to become other shapes (flickers briefly into a ghost of other items/forms) and snaps back

name: Echo of the Transcendental
lore: The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.
concept: a hollow ringing sphere with the faint image of the Transcendental disc (golden-angle spiral, halo) inside; concentric echo rings expand and fade; the image inside fades out and back in like a memory

name: Omnipotence Dust
lore: Ground Omnipotence. Each grain can still be anything - for a moment.
concept: a small heap of glittering white-gold dust; grains briefly lift and swirl into a tiny Core shape before collapsing back into the pile

name: Apeiron Ingot
lore: Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.
concept: "the boundless" ingot: its silhouette is an ingot whose ends dissolve into infinity (repeating, shrinking copies receding / Droste), edges shimmer; pale lilac-white with gold

name: Pleroma Crystal
lore: Pleroma - the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.
concept: "fullness": a crystal that contains every law - tiny coloured glyph motes of every colour orbiting INSIDE the crystal; periodically fills with light until it overflows with a flash, then empties and refills

name: Logos Thread
lore: A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.
concept: a glowing golden strand/thread that writes itself: it traces a curve, ties into a knot or a word-like loop, then unravels and rewrites

name: Rekindled Spark
lore: What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.
concept: the first light of a second creation: a tiny spark that blooms into a miniature big bang (expanding shell of colour) and condenses back to a spark

name: Omnipotent Ingot
lore: Metal that is whatever metal it needs to be. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.
concept: the final ingot - brighter and more spectacular than Omnium: pure white-gold ingot that becomes every other ingot shape for an instant (morph ingot -> sphere -> star -> ingot), crown of light rays, prismatic outline flash; must top omnium_ingot in tools/art14/g0.py

name: Crystal of Transcendence
lore: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.
concept: a crystal that steps outside itself: it rotates in 4D (a crystal tesseract-like projection) - its facets turn inside out through a centre point and come back

name: Absolute Singularity
lore: Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.
concept: black point with a white rim where no laws exist: it is NOT lensed or accreting like other singularities - instead space around it is erased into flat white/black inversion that pulses; geometry around it falls away

name: Eschaton Core
lore: The end of all things, held still in a cage of Omnipotent metal. Every endgame artefact is built around one.
concept: "the end of all things held still": a cage of white-gold Omnipotent metal bars (like a gimbal of 3 rings) around a core that shows the universe ending (stars dimming, collapsing) and restarting
